plugins.name: prompt-optimizer
plugins.description: /optimize rewrites a draft prompt with repo context and fills it into the composer

plugins.name: handoff
plugins.description: /handoff summarizes the session into a prompt a fresh session can pick up, saved per project under ~/.claude/handoffs; /handoff new continues it in a fresh session; open questions of a recap are asked before it is saved

plugins.name: brainstorm
plugins.description: /brainstorm studies the project and brainstorms ideas in the browser, saved under ~/.claude/brainstorm/<project>/; /brainstorm plan turns picked ideas into a small-step plan; /brainstorm build has small-model subagents implement it and a strong model review it

plugins.name: draft-pr
plugins.description: /draft-pr drafts a pull request in the project's PR template; /draft-pr-review drafts a review as Conventional Comments; each opens an editable page in the browser that posts to GitHub only when you click

plugins.name: adhd-style
plugins.description: ADHD output style: answer first, short chunks, one next step

plugins.name: code-style
plugins.description: Comment and naming rules at session start; hooks block comments, short or vague identifiers, and finishing before a naming review

plugins.name: tdd
plugins.description: Red, green, refactor enforced: the TDD rules at session start; hooks block implementation edits until a failing test run is recorded and block finishing while tests fail

plugins.name: quality-gates
plugins.description: Blocks git commit and push when fallow audit fails, finishing a turn or subagent while lint or fallow audit fails, and finishing a turn that changed code without a verification step

plugins.name: guards
plugins.description: Command guards: caps unbounded git log, diff and find, trims long Bash and MCP output and saves the full text to a file, blocks commits that skip hooks or fail the project's checks, limits Reads of large files, forces context-heavy lookups onto the Haiku context-scout subagent, and, opted in, asks for a browser check after UI edits

plugins.name: ui-design
plugins.description: /ui-design new and /ui-design redesign open mockups in the browser, built from the project's own colors, type, spacing and components; redesign asks for the go-ahead before it changes project code; /ui-design audit checks the theme, the components and their consistency; /ui-design apply builds the picked variant of a saved design in project code; /ui-design fix fixes numbered audit findings in project code

plugins.name: project-notes
plugins.description: Claude writes categorised project notes (fact, finding, decision, reference, debugging) as Markdown files under ~/.claude/project-notes/<project>/<category>/; a debugging note must hold the reasoning, steps, evidence, findings, next steps and a drafted Shortcut ticket; /project-notes organise files existing session notes the same way

plugins.name: small-plans
plugins.description: /small-plans breaks work into small, self-contained plans a weaker model can implement and review, saved under ~/.claude/small-plans/<project>/<set>/; the work is what you name, what the conversation leaves, or with handoff what a saved handoff leaves; /small-plans build has small-model agents implement a whole set or one plan while the session reviews and sends back fixes

plugins.name: token-ledger
plugins.description: Records each session's token use (main session and subagents, per model, cache reads and writes, tool result size per tool) under ~/.cache/token-ledger, prints a report of recent sessions, and suggests /handoff then /clear when the context grows large
